basic_info.description: Rarely do you get an opportunity to purchase a flat in North Beach that has a private, panoramic view roof deck! This vibrant 2BR/1BA flat with 1-car parking is located on the top floor of a small boutique art-deco building. A few steps above the flat is your private outdoor oasis with views from the Golden Gate through to the FiDi. The contemporary-styled unit has an open, entertaining style floor plan that with numerous upgrades including a chef's kitchen with Bertazzoni range, stainless appliances, custom built-in workstation, hand-tiled bath, in-unit laundry, recessed lighting, tankless h2o heater and double pane windows. The building went through a full renovation in approx. 2012 that included new electrical, plumbing, seismic and structural upgrades, new stucco exterior, new fire suppression and alarm system. Located a few blocks to great restaurants, the Embarcadero, local watering holes, Trader Joe's and public transportation make this a fantastic offering.
